correctness.rationale: For each n>=7 and deleted distance d=1 or d=2, a closed walk of length n in the explicitly specified four-letter de Bruijn transfer is equivalent to a labelled pair (x,y) with y=F(x), x=F(y). Restricting letters to x=y gives precisely fixed points. Exact integer matrices of dimensions 256 and 16 therefore calculate P_n and H_n. By Cayley--Hamilton, D_n=P_n-H_n obeys a recurrence of order at most 272; so D_(n+12)-D_n also does. The included checker verifies 272 consecutive zeros for n=7..278 and the twelve initial values, proving the closed formula for all n>=7. The second independent direct graph-update enumeration verifies all 261888 states across n=7..16 and both edge deletions. Outputs are embedded; all conclusions depend only on reproducible exact arithmetic and the stated recurrence.

value.rationale: A single local perturbation of the natural range-two majority ring induces a global and graph-theoretically selective oscillation effect. Two geometrically inequivalent missing edges have different exact laws: only removal of a distance-two bond creates an oscillation at every odd length n=3 mod 4, while no growing family of other 2-cycles appears. This is a complete natural infinite-family classification of a dynamically meaningful invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact bound of four temporal orbits, the modular existence theorem, and the labelled seven-vertex witness distinguish defect response from the known uniform spatial periodicity classification. The finding is self-contained and independently reproducible modulo the stated historical priority risk.
